card.text: HAT-P-36 b was found in 2011 by HATNet as it crossed its star.

sources.label: Wikipedia, "HAT-P-36"
sources.quote: In December 2019, HAT-P-36 was named Tuiren and its planetary companion, HAT-P-36b, was named Bran as a result of Ireland's contribution to the 2019 NameExoWorlds campaign.

introduction.text: It is the only planet known around Tuiren. Its orbit and size follow Chakrabarty & Sengupta 2019's fit, the archive's default.

sources.label: Wikipedia, "HAT-P-36"
sources.quote: Bran has a mass approximately 1.8 times that of Jupiter and a radius 1.2 times larger.
